entries.title: John 7:1
segments: After this, Jesus went about in Galilee, for he would not do so in Judea, because the Jews were eager to put him to death.

entries.title: John 7:2
segments: When the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,

entries.title: John 7:3
segments: His brothers said to him: "Leave this part of the country, and go into Judea, so that your disciples, as well as we, may see the work that you are doing.

entries.title: John 7:4
segments: For no one does a thing privately, if he is seeking to be widely known. Since you do these things, you should show yourself publicly to the world."

entries.title: John 7:5
segments: For even his brothers did not believe in him.

entries.title: John 7:6
segments: "My time," answered Jesus, "is not come yet, but your time is always here.

entries.title: John 7:7
segments: The world cannot hate you, but it does hate me, because I testify that its ways are evil.

entries.title: John 7:8
segments: Go yourselves up to the Festival; I am not going to this Festival yet, because my time has not yet come."

entries.title: John 7:9
segments: After telling them this, he stayed on in Galilee.

entries.title: John 7:10
segments: But, when his brothers had gone up to the Festival, Jesus also went up--not publicly, but privately.

entries.title: John 7:11
segments: The Jews were looking for him at the Festival and asking 'Where is he?';

entries.title: John 7:12
segments: And there were many whispers about him among the people, some saying 'He is a good man;' others: 'No! he is leading the people astray.'

entries.title: John 7:13
segments: No one, however, spoke freely about him, for fear of the Jews.

entries.title: John 7:14
segments: About the middle of the Festival week, Jesus went up into the Temple Courts, and began teaching.

entries.title: John 7:15
segments: The Jews were astonished. "How has this man got his learning," they asked, "when he has never studied?"

entries.title: John 7:16
segments: So, in reply, Jesus said: "My teaching is not my own; it is his who sent me.

entries.title: John 7:17
segments: If any one has the will to do God's will, he will find out whether my teaching is from God, or whether I speak on my own authority.

entries.title: John 7:18
segments: The man who speaks on his own authority seeks honor for himself; but the man who seeks the honor of him that sent him is sincere, and there is nothing false in him.

entries.title: John 7:19
segments: Was not it Moses who gave you the Law? Yet not one of you obeys it! Why are you seeking to put me to death?"

entries.title: John 7:20
segments: "You must be possessed by a demon!" the people exclaimed. "Who is seeking to put you to death?"

entries.title: John 7:21
segments: "There was one thing I did," replied Jesus, "at which you are all still wondering.

entries.title: John 7:22
segments: But that is why Moses has instituted circumcision among you- -not, indeed, that it began with him, but with our ancestors--and that is why you circumcise even on a Sabbath.

entries.title: John 7:23
segments: When a man receives circumcision on a Sabbath to prevent the Law of Moses from being broken, how can you be angry with me for making a man sound and well on a Sabbath?

entries.title: John 7:24
segments: Do not judge by appearances; judge justly."

entries.title: John 7:25
segments: At this some of the people of Jerusalem exclaimed: "Is not this the man that they are seeking to put to death?

entries.title: John 7:26
segments: Yet here he is, speaking out boldly, and they say nothing to him! Is it possible that our leading men have really discovered that he is the Christ?

entries.title: John 7:27
segments: Yet we know where this man is from; but, when the Christ comes, no one will be able to tell where he is from."

entries.title: John 7:28
segments: Therefore, Jesus, as he was teaching in the Temple Courts, raised his voice and said: "Yes; you know me and you know where I am from. Yet I have not come on my own authority, but he who sent me may be trusted; and him you do not know.

entries.title: John 7:29
segments: I do know him, for it is from him that I have come, and he sent me as his Messenger."

entries.title: John 7:30
segments: So they sought to arrest him; but no one touched him, for his time was not come yet.

entries.title: John 7:31
segments: Many of the people, however, believed in him. "When the Christ comes," they said, "will he give more signs of his mission than this man has given?"

entries.title: John 7:32
segments: The Pharisees heard the people whispering about him in this way, and so the Chief Priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him;

entries.title: John 7:33
segments: On which Jesus said: "I shall be with you but a little longer, and then I am going to him who sent me.

entries.title: John 7:34
segments: You will look for me, and you will not find me; and you will not be able to come where I shall be."

entries.title: John 7:35
segments: "Where is this man going," the Jews asked one another, "that we shall not find him? Will he go to our countrymen abroad, and teach foreigners?

entries.title: John 7:36
segments: What does he mean by saying 'You will look for me, and you will not find me; and you will not be able to come where I shall be'?"

entries.title: John 7:37
segments: On the last and greatest day of the Festival, Jesus, who was standing by, exclaimed: "If any one thirsts, let him come to me, and drink.

entries.title: John 7:38
segments: He who believes in me--As Scripture says, Out of his heart shall flow rivers of 'Living Water.'"

entries.title: John 7:39
segments: (By this he meant the Spirit, which those who had believed in him were to receive; for the Spirit had not yet come, because Jesus had not yet been exalted.)

entries.title: John 7:40
segments: Some of the people, when they heard these words, said:

entries.title: John 7:41
segments: "This is certainly 'the Prophet'!"; others said: "This is the Christ!"; but some asked: "What! does the Christ come from Galilee?

entries.title: John 7:42
segments: Is not it said in Scripture that it is of the race of David, and from Bethlehem, the village to which David belonged, that the Christ is to come?"

entries.title: John 7:43
segments: So there was a sharp division among the people on account of Jesus.

entries.title: John 7:44
segments: Some of them wanted to arrest him, and yet no one touched him.

entries.title: John 7:45
segments: When the officers returned to the Chief Priests and Pharisees, they were asked: "Why have you not brought him?"

entries.title: John 7:46
segments: "No man ever spoke as he speaks!" they answered.

entries.title: John 7:47
segments: "What! Have you been led astray too?" the Pharisees replied.

entries.title: John 7:48
segments: "Have any of our leading men believed in him, or any of the Pharisees?

entries.title: John 7:49
segments: As for these people who do not know the Law--they are cursed!"

entries.title: John 7:50
segments: But one of their number, Nicodemus, who before this had been to see Jesus, said to them:

entries.title: John 7:51
segments: "Does our Law pass judgement on a man without first giving him a hearing, and finding out what he has been doing?"

entries.title: John 7:52
segments: "Are you also from Galilee?" they retorted. "Search, and you will find that no Prophet is to arise in Galilee!"

entries.title: John 7:53
segments: (Translation omits this verse)
